headline: Coolfly’s solar-powered Aura Smart Bird Feeder is nearly 50 percent off
summary: Coolfly's Aura Smart Bird Feeder is now almost 50% off. This camera-equipped, solar-powered device lets you birdwatch remotely. Birdfy also offers discounts on their smart feeders.

headline: Coolpad’s new $150 Android phone has a wider screen like the iPhone Duo, but doesn’t fold
summary: Coolpad launched a new $150 Android phone, the Cool X Wide. It features a wider screen design, similar to folding phones like iPhone Duo. Unlike foldables, this budget phone maintains a traditional slab form factor.

headline: Bill Gates says to prepare for 20 years of ‘tumultuous’ AI disruption
summary: Bill Gates warns of two decades of significant AI disruption. He has been on a tour discussing the turbulent AI era. Gates emphasizes preparing for the impact of artificial intelligence.

headline: Apple will label apps that are ‘Made for iPhone Duo’
summary: Apple is introducing a new 'Made for iPhone Duo' badge. This badge will identify apps optimized for its new foldable device. It helps users find apps leveraging the iPhone Duo's extra screen.

headline: First GTA 6 TV Commercial Strips Out Steamy Shower Scenes, but Shows More of Lucia's Fancy Hair Tech
summary: The first GTA 6 TV commercial has been released. It omits steamy shower scenes seen in the launch trailer. The ad highlights new details, like Lucia's advanced hair tech.

headline: Mass Effect 5 Trailer Reportedly Ready to Go Before BioWare Closure
summary: A Mass Effect 5 trailer was reportedly complete. This trailer was ready before the game's cancellation. The news follows reports of BioWare's closure by EA.

headline: DevGAMM Awards 2026 Reveals 70 Nominated Games For Its 3rd Annual Show: See the Full List
summary: The DevGAMM Awards 2026 announced 70 nominated games. The third annual show celebrates titles from 25 countries. The awards ceremony is scheduled for November 18, 2026.

headline: Before There Was Heated Rivalry, There Was Yuri!!! On Ice
summary: The anime 'Yuri!!! On Ice' is celebrated ten years on. It remains a special and groundbreaking series. The show holds a unique place in anime history.

headline: AI discovered a massive cyber-security flaw - here's what happened
summary: AI has identified a significant cybersecurity vulnerability. The BBC's Joe Tidy explains the discovery. Learn about the implications for you and your security.

headline: Barclays cutting 5,000 jobs as it increases reliance on AI
summary: Barclays plans to cut 5,000 jobs from its workforce. The bank is increasing its reliance on AI technology. This move results in a 5% reduction in staffing.

headline: Russell Brand accuser said alleged rape 'really hurt', court hears
summary: A Russell Brand accuser testified her alleged rape 'really hurt'. A friend corroborated her statement, citing Brand's 'aggressive' behavior. The details emerged during a court hearing.

headline: Moment man rescued from sinking car by Australian TV reporter
summary: An Australian TV reporter, Will Murray, rescued a man. The man was saved from his sinking SUV with a bystander's help. Murray recounted the dramatic rescue incident.
